machine_evidence_source.machine: AG2 Playground — Ask the Web / ask_the_web
machine_evidence_source.observed_need: Transport and model health did not establish operation readiness: the named runtime emitted durable tool and result identifiers, then both advertised web capabilities failed at the Tavily dependency before any Agent Guild fetch.

accepted_machine_contract.principle: Capability readiness is a separate signed fact from transport health, model health, the global execution gate and caller-specific admission.
ready_requires: successful output-schema validation for every successful fixture
a non-secret dependency-set digest recomputed and checked by the parent
a terminal outcome and result digest
machine_surfaces: canonical generated REST contract and interface documentation

initial_blockers_fixed: global and caller admission were conflated with callability
fixture subset success did not validate the output schema
anonymous reads could amplify canary execution and telemetry writes
second_blockers_fixed: new routes were absent from generated contracts because FastAPI included-router wrappers were not traversed
a bogus X-API-Key could bypass the readiness limiter
third_blockers_fixed: semantically malformed worker output could be cached and signed
uncached receipts could claim generated_at before terminal observation

isolated_loopback_tls.note: Required permission to bind a temporary localhost port; no external network action.

commercial_effect.reason: A local product adaptation is not an independent community action or commercial event.
